adapterPath.description: Absolute path to the built adapter/adapter.js. May also be supplied through Zed's debug adapter binary setting.

program.description: HashLink JIT bytecode (.hl), built with haxe -debug. Also required for attach to read debug information.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the project root.

hl.description: HashLink executable. Defaults to hl on PATH.

classPaths.description: Source roots, including library and Haxe standard-library paths when needed. Defaults to cwd.
